B2_gaussian_wavefunction.statement: The ALICE paper reports that the Gaussian deuteron wave function gives the best description of B2 among the compared wave functions; this is not an independent numerical reproduction.

B3_gaussian_wavefunction.statement: Publisher PDF section 4.1 states the Gaussian helion prediction is above data by almost a factor of two except for the last pT interval, which is consistent within uncertainties. This is a reported paper-level comparison, not independent numerical validation.

complete_coalescence_model.statement: No point-level extraction, independent model implementation, residual calculation, or held-out validation has been performed.

source_facts.B_definition: B_A = invariant spectrum of the nucleus divided by the A-th power of the invariant proton spectrum, with proton spectrum evaluated at pT/A.
source_facts.source_overlap_model: For B2, the paper defines an overlap integral of the deuteron Wigner density with a two-nucleon source correlation; the Gaussian source assumption is homogeneous with R = R_parallel = R_perpendicular.
source_facts.A12_gate: BLOCKED: a normalized, independently checkable 12-body phase-space overlap and uncertainty model have not been established.

stopping_decision.authorized_claim: The source audit identifies a reproducible starting point and a concrete model-validation obstacle. It does not establish an anti-carbon-12 production yield.

reproducibility.reason: Publisher PDF was read through a web PDF viewer; binary bytes could not be downloaded to the working container for hashing or programmatic image digitization.

next_required_objects: Resolve dataset DOI 10.17182/HEPDATA.115571 to a verified HEPData record/table export; keep ins1928822 marked unverified unless independently confirmed.
Create B2/B3 CSVs with pT/A, central value, statistical uncertainty, systematic uncertainty, multiplicity class, and any visibility scale factor.
Replay at least one selected source table or digitized figure independently and report residuals and digitization tolerance.
Only then implement the paper's B2/B3 equations with explicit units and compare against published results.
Do not attempt A=12 until a valid many-body overlap and uncertainty propagation are justified.
